'''Tin''' is a crafting material smelted from [[Tin Ore]] in a [[Smelter]].

Just like [[Copper Ore]], [[Tin Ore]] can only be found in the [[Black Forest]] [[Biomes|biome]]. It takes the form of small shiny rock-like deposits on the ground near water (ocean & river shorelines, or small inland lakes).

An [[Antler Pickaxe]] or better is required to mine the rocks, which yield 2-4 Tin ore each.

One Tin can be processed with two [[Copper]] on the [[Forge]] to create one [[Bronze]]. There is also an alternate recipe to craft 5 Bronze at a time given sufficient materials (10 copper, 5 tin).

'''Copper Ore''' can be refined into [[Copper]] in a [[Smelter]].

Two Copper can be further processed at a [[Forge]] with [[Tin]] to yield [[Bronze]].

== Availability ==
It can be mined from [[Copper Deposit]]s which can be found in [[Black Forest]] [[biomes]] using any [[Pickaxes (skill)|Pickaxe]]. Such deposits have subtle bronze-colored streaks that reflect the sunlight. It is the only visual feature that distinguishes them from typical stone boulders.

Copper deposits are generated in a large size which extends down into the ground, so digging deep underneath the surface is necessary to fully extract a single deposit.

== Notes ==
* A way of farming Copper is to dig the earth all around the deposit until it crumbles on itself into Copper Ores. 
* Like other metals, Copper Ore cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]].
* The attacks of a [[Troll]], despite being harmless to normal terrain, cause immense damage to Copper Ore. If the player has no pickaxe or simply yearns for a change from their usual monotonous mining method, a Troll can make for a great alternative.

'''Ancient Trees''' are a type of [[Trees|tree]] that can be found in the [[Swamp]] biome. They are characterized by their lack of leaves, and gnarled shape. A [[Bronze Axe]], [[Early Axes]], or better is required to damage it.

Ancient Trees produce [[Wood]] and [[Ancient Bark]] when destroyed. The yield of each type of wood appears to be random, however an ancient tree will always drop 10 pieces of wood in total.

== Notes ==
* While farming this tree, a player can avoid [[Leech]]es by using a [[Hoe]] and raising the ground level to pass through the water safely.
* Do not confuse this tree with fallen trees on the ground ([[Swamp]] only). Fallen trees are just a mesh and cannot be farmed in any way! '''Trees''' are the primary source of wood. When destroyed, a full-grown tree will become a giant log that will fall over and collide with any objects in its path. Logs drop various types of wood, depending on the kind of tree. Stumps always drop ordinary wood.

== Types of trees ==

Can be found in the [[Meadows]].

=== [[Birch]] ===

=== [[Oak]] ===

=== [[Fir]] ===
Can be found in the [[Black Forest]], [[Swamp]] and [[Mountain]].

=== [[Pine]] ===
Can be found in the [[Black Forest]].

=== [[Ancient Tree]] ===
Can be found in the [[Swamp]].

=== [[Yggdrasil Shoot]] ===
Can be found in the [[Mistlands]].

=== [[Scorched Tree]] ===
Can be found in the [[Ashlands]].

=== [[Timber Tree]] ===
Can be found in the [[Deep North]].

== Growing behavior ==
Cut forests do not regrow, and naturally occurring small trees (large saplings labelled Beech, Fir, or Pine) do not grow into full sized trees.  Some have reported trees spontaneously appearing on rare occasions, but this will not replace a cut forest (and is quite rare).

It is, however, possible to plant tree saplings using the [[Cultivator]] and [[:Category:Seeds|seeds]] from some tree species. Planted saplings grow into large trees over time. A sapling will grow into a tree after a random passage of time, between 3,000 and 8,000 seconds (between 50 minutes and 2 hours 13 minutes 20 seconds, or about 1.67–4.44 in-game days). Keep in mind that some trees have a shorter maximum growth time and some have a longer minimum growth time.  For tree farms, it is recommended that you plant each sapling 4 meters apart in order to avoid overcrowding, which will eliminate some saplings as surrounding trees mature.  Spacing can be measured by placing poles along one edge of the farm for reference, with the spacing measured by temporarily placing two 2-meter beams.

Ancient trees, Yggdrasil shoots and Scorched Trees do not produce seeds and cannot be planted with the cultivator.

[[Ancient Armor]] | usage = Smelting | buy = | sell = | weight = 10.0 | stack = 30 | teleport = No }} '''Scrap Iron''' is a raw metal that can be turned into [[Iron]] in a [[Smelter]] using [[Coal]] as fuel. == Availability == In the [[Swamp]], its primary source are [[Sunken Crypts]]. There, it can be mined from [[Muddy Scrap Pile]]s using any pickaxe, or found inside [[Chest]]s. The [[Swamp Key]], obtained from the [[Elder]], has to be obtained to access Sunken Crypts. Alternatively, Muddy scrap piles can be found underground in Swamps. However, these are scarce, and ultimately yield little Iron scrap. They can be located using a [[Wishbone]] or by using the [[How to play#How_to_prospect_properly?|Prospecting]] method with a [[Stagbreaker]] or Weapons with the same attack ([[Iron Sledge]]). [[Oozer]]s can also rarely drop Scrap iron with a drop rate of around 30%. Later in the game, Iron and [[Copper Scrap]] can be obtained by mining [[Ancient Sword]]s and [[Ancient Armor]] in the [[Mistlands]]. == Notes == * Like other metals, Scrap Iron cannot be teleported without a [[Portal stone]]. * Scrap iron ore is 2 units lighter than smelted Iron. {{MaterialsNav}} [[ru:Металлолом]] [[cs:Železný šrot]] [[uk:Металобрухт]] [[de:Eisenschrott]] [[fr:Ferraille]]

{{infobox character | name = Hildir | image = Hildir Definitive.png | caption = | id = Hildir | aliases = | affiliation = | marital = | birthDate = | birthPlace = | deathDate = | deathPlace = | species = Dvergr | gender = Female | height = | weight = | eyes = Light blue |Release Ver.=[[Version history#0.217.14_-_Hildir's_Request|0.217.4]]}} '''Hildir''' is a [[Creatures#NPCs|character]] found in [[Meadows]]. Like her brother, [[Haldor]], she is a [[Dvergr (race)|Dvergr]]. She wears a red and white dress, a green and red necklace and a headband. At her camp, which was recently raided, Hildir sells several unique items that can be purchased for [[Coins]]. ==Biography== ''Hildir'' also speaks, like [[Haldor]], saying sentences like, "My wares are made out of the finest cloth," and "You'll only find products of the finest quality in my shop, I assure you." She has two [[Lox]], named [[Blåbär]] and [[Hallon]]. ==Location== [[File:Hildur's Camp Screenshot.jpg|thumb|right|300px]]Hildir has a similar spawning system to Haldor with 10 possible spawn locations that are located in [[Meadows]], each at least 1000 meters apart, and only found between 3000 and 5100 metersThe game will actually attempt to spawn Hildir between 3000 and 8000 meters from the center of the world. However, Meadows biomes only extend up to 5100 meters, which reduces the viable range down to 3000 - 5100 meters. from the world center. Approaching any of these locations will permanently place Hildir there. When discovered, her dress icon will appear on the world map. She spawns with her own [[Points of Interest (POI)|point of interest]], a small camp consisting of a large wagon, with multiple tents, barrels, her own [[Iron Fire Pit]], and multiple divans the player can sit on, and tables. Like the other traders, the camp is surrounded by a shimmering transparent dome that acts as a safety zone that [[Creatures]] cannot enter. The safe zone cannot be destroyed. ==Quests== Hildir has a map table in front of her that leads to various different locations where special dungeons with special minibosses can be fought, and different loot is found. Interacting with the table adds the locations to the player's map. The locations are: * [[Smouldering Tomb]] in [[Black Forest]] * [[Howling Cavern]] in [[Mountains]] * [[Sealed Tower]] in [[Plains]] Up to three of each type of these locations will generate in each world. The spawning rules for each location type are as follows: * Smouldering Tombs: Each 3000 meters apart, between 3000 - 8000 meters from the world center, at an altitude of at least 1 meter. * Howling Caverns: Each 2000 meters apart, between 1000 - 8000 meters from the world center, at an altitude of at least 200 meters. * Sealed Tower: Each 3000 meters apart, at an altitude of at least 8 meters. When players find Hildir, it can be a good idea to drop a [[Portal]] in the vicinity to make easier returns. Each of these quest locations is full of loot, enemies, and unique minibosses. Once defeated, these minibosses each drop a quest item: * {{Item Link|Hildir's brass chest|size=64px}}, dropped by [[Brenna]] in the [[Smouldering Tomb]] * {{Item Link|Hildir's silver chest|size=64px}}, dropped by [[Geirrhafa]] in the [[Howling Cavern]] * {{Item Link|Hildir's bronze chest|size=64px}}, dropped by [[Zil]] of [[Zil & Thungr]] in the [[Sealed Tower]] Each of these chests weighs 200.0, has a stack size of 1, and '''cannot be teleported''' via [[Portal]]. They can, however, be teleported with a [[Portal stone]]. Chests can be returned to Hildir, which unlocks additional trades from her; note that only one of each type of chest can be returned. Defeating one of these minibosses will enable new [[Events]], which will cause that boss and their minions to invade the player's base. Hildir Picture.png File:Simple Dress.png File:HildirItemsList.png File:Simple and Cape Tunics.png File:Beaded Tunic.png File:Shaw Dress.png File:Beaded Dress.png ==Trivia == *The transparent dome which surrounded Hildir's camp is the same as Haldor's camp and apparently powered by four small runestones placed around it and that each of them carved with Odin's Illusory Rune, a Viking glyph devised to provide camouflage and deception. This is fitting as the barrier only allows Hildir's and Haldor's potential customers to both see their camps and pass through it while hostile beings such as Greydwarfs cannot enter. *The names of Hildir's Lox, Blåbär and Hallon, are Swedish for blueberry and raspberry, respectively. *How Hildir explains the event of her chests being robbed suggests [[Brenna]], [[Geirrhafa|Geirhaffa]], [[Zil & Thungr|Zil & Thunger]], all teamed up to steal from her. However, in game the minibosses all fight each other. *Blåbär and Hallon are females judging by one of Hildir's lines of text. ==References== {{Creatures}} [[Category:NPCs]] [[ru:Хильдир]]

{{Infobox tree |title1=Scorched Tree |image1=Scorched Trees.webp |biome=[[Ashlands]] |wood_type=[[Ashwood]] and [[Wood]] |yield=20 |tool_needed=[[Stone Axe]] |additional_loot=[[Charcoal Resin]] }} '''Scorched Tree''' is a type of [[trees|tree]] encountered in the [[Ashlands]] biome. They are black, tall, and menacing, with crooked branches and a looming figure. Scorched Trees are a source of [[Ashwood]], the Ashlands-tier wood. In addition, small amounts of [[Wood]] and [[Charcoal Resin]] can be obtained from them. Getting struck by a Scorched Tree log inflicts [[Burning]]. ==Drop== {| class="wikitable" |+Tree: 50% chance for 2 drops !Item !Amount !Chance !Average |- | [[Ashwood]] (66.7%) or
[[Wood]] (33.3%) |20 |From logs | 13.3 Ashwood
6.6 Wood |- |[[Ashwood]] |2 |From stump |2 |- |[[Ashwood]] | 1-4 | 33% from tree fall | 0.75 |- |[[Charcoal Resin]] | 1-2 | 17% | 0.25 |} == Planting == Scorched Trees cannot be planted, nor do they regrow naturally. Thus, Ashwood and Charcoal resin are limited resources. However, despite the overall size of the biome, scorched trees are highly plentiful throughout the landscape, making ashwood a very easily obtainable resource, and as of the Ashlands update, charcoal resin has no uses outside of building green pots. == '''Trivia''' == Scorched Trees are so far, the only trees that have multiple different looking tree models.{{WorldNav}} [[ru:Горелое дерево]] [[Category:Trees]]
